fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Pre Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Combined State Upper Subordinate Services Examination 2026 on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 500 posts. The online application process for UPPSC Pre Recruitment 2026 has started from 25 June 2026, and candidates can apply until 27 July 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPPSC Pre Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 June 2026
  • Last Date : 27 July 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 25 June 2026 to 08 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 125/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 65/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-
  • The candidate can pay the fee through online via Credit Card / Debit Card Or  Net Banking or through SBI Challan.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPPSC Pre Online Form 2026?

UPPSC Pre Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 27 July 2025.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://uppsc.up.nic.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
